title: HB77 (2026 Regular): AN ACT relating to ex parte orders.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Kentucky); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Kentucky text (Introduced, 0000-00-00; official copy, https://apps.legislature.ky.gov/recorddocuments/bill/26RS/hb77/orig_bill.pdf (LegiScan doc 3302104))
provenance.note: Introduced version (26 RS BR 246); later amendments not in text read. No votes recorded. Act is titled the Red Flag Repeal Act of 2026 (Section 4). Other bracketed edits in Sections 2 and 3 are unrelated wording changes.

operative_text:
Section 1 (new section of KRS 237.060 to 237.090): Notwithstanding any other provision of law, ex parte orders issued in the Commonwealth shall not prohibit a person from possessing, purchasing, selling, or otherwise transferring firearms, ammunition, firearm accessories, holsters, or firearm storage devices, nor compel a person to surrender his or her firearms, ammunition, firearm accessories, holsters, or firearm storage devices.
Section 2 (KRS 403.730): (2)(b) An order issued under this subsection shall not prohibit a person from possessing, purchasing, selling, or otherwise transferring firearms, ammunition, firearm accessories, holsters, or firearm storage devices, nor compel a person to surrender his or her firearms, ammunition, firearm accessories, holsters, or firearm storage devices.
Section 3 (KRS 456.040): (2)(b) An order issued under this subsection shall not prohibit a person from possessing, purchasing, selling, or otherwise transferring firearms, ammunition, firearm accessories, holsters, or firearm storage devices, nor compel a person to surrender his or her firearms, ammunition, firearm accessories, holsters, or firearm storage devices.
